Also independently confirmed via two more real-git probes that the absent-vs-unreadable regex patterns match real git stderr output verbatim, and that a normal nonzero git exit leaves err.code undefined (so it is never misclassified as absent through the nodeLevelFailure gate) while ENOBUFS always sets err.code so it can never be misclassified as absent.
